rules.condition: AHB transfer has unsupported size, misaligned address or reserved transfer encoding
rules.statement: The bridge must return AHB ERROR for unsupported size, misaligned address or reserved transfer encodings without issuing any AXI transaction.
The bridge must not provide an interrupt/event output; errors are reported only as synchronous AHB responses.
The AHB transfer remains pending when the AXI response never arrives, with no out-of-band error notification.
AHB, AXI and all FIFO instances must use one shared rising-edge clock input i_clk_core.
The bridge must reject transfers with HPROT[6] equal to 1.

rules.condition: AXI response is non-OKAY, including unexpected EXOKAY
rules.statement: A non-OKAY AXI response, including unexpected EXOKAY, must map to a two-cycle AHB ERROR response.

rules.condition: Eligible Normal Write-back bufferable fixed write has an error
rules.statement: Errors of eligible Normal Write-back bufferable fixed writes must be reported at the terminal AHB beat.
Device-E and non-bufferable writes must wait for BRESP on each beat.

rules.condition: queue space available and READY high
rules.statement: The bridge must issue a request within 6 i_clk_core cycles when queue space exists and READY is high.
System reset controller and AXI endpoint must follow the shared reset contract.
Open items OI-001 through OI-006 remain TBD pending SoC integration inputs; they are required for timing closure, latency validation, area closure, reset policy and tool selection.
SoC scan insertion and FIFO memory test are external integration responsibilities.
